completeness_scope: TSTable records in original retained graph process context plus ten source-confirmed tables of the exact same five editions and direct section owners;80 caption records include62 Wordtables and18 original authoredVoid records. Not all-spec physical source completeness.
original_query: MATCH (rk:Spec {specNumber:'38.133'})<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(sec:Section {sectionNumber:'9.2.5.1'}) WHERE rk.specRelease IS NOT NULL WITH sec,rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC LIMIT 1 MATCH (sec)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(t:TSTable) RETURN t.tableId, t.tableNumber, t.tableCaption ORDER BY t.tableNumber LIMIT 25
question_en: List the tables in section 9.2.5.1 of spec 38.133 (locating requirement tables).
reference_query:
MATCH (hub:Spec {specNumber: '38.133'})
WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL
MATCH (edition:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub)
MATCH (anchor:Section {sectionNumber: '9.2.5.1'})-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(edition)
MATCH (anchor)-[:CONTAINS_TABLE]->(obj:TSTable)
RETURN DISTINCT obj.tableId AS tableId, obj.tableNumber AS tableNumber, obj.tableCaption AS tableCaption
ORDER BY tableId
